purpose: Tepegoz target classes and how each public dataset's labels map onto them. null = the dataset has no usable label for that class.

classes.name: rider
classes.note: person on bicycle/motorcycle; falls back to person when a dataset has no rider label

classes.name: two_wheeler
classes.note: bicycle + motorcycle merged; small, few samples per class otherwise

classes.name: traffic_sign
classes.note: one generic class at detection stage; sign type is a second-stage classifier

classes.name: lane
classes.note: NOT a box class; handled by the lane head (YOLOP/UFLD-style)

classes.name: obstacle
classes.note: unknown objects on the road; needs depth/free-space or anomaly segmentation, not a closed-set box class
